original: Brings your own HELLDIVERS 2 account into this profile. Warbonds, Superstore items and DLC gear you bought always follow your latest sync; everything else is imported only as you choose, and the profile is backed up first. Super Credits are never imported or usable. Sync opens the normal game through Steam; log in and pass the title screen. Each sync asks for administrator access: until the normal game exits, the game's server name points at this PC and a temporary certificate is trusted. Both are removed when it exits.
translation: 将你自己的 HELLDIVERS 2 账户引入此档案。你购买的战争债券、超级商店物品与 DLC装备始终跟随最近一次同步；其余内容只按你的选择导入，导入前会先备份档案。超级货币从不导入，也无法使用。同步会通过 Steam 打开正常游戏，登录并通过标题界面即可。每次同步都会请求管理员权限：在正常游戏退出前，游戏的服务器名会指向这台电脑，并临时信任一张证书。游戏退出后，两者都会被移除。
note: 账户同步卡片长说明，含 Warbonds、Superstore items、DLC gear、Super Credits 等游戏专名；术语官方简中未核对，转 PM-02。 用户裁定 PM-02：Warbonds 战争债券、Superstore items 超级商店物品、DLC gear DLC装备、Super Credits 超级货币。 合并自 modules/profiles-mods.csv。
